Bare URL links rendered as regular markdown links when autolinks disabled

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p><a href='https://example.com'>https://example.com</a></p>", HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(autolinks: false))
puts result.content.inspect
```
